title: SparkLend quarantines risk on both sides of a loan, with isolated collateral and siloed borrowing as mirror mechanisms
content:
SparkLend defines two containment parameters that operate on opposite legs of a position.

**Isolated collateral** constrains the debt side of a risky *collateral*: "If Isolated Collateral is Enabled, only Stablecoins can be borrowed when using the asset as collateral" (A.6.1.1.1.3.2.1.1.1.20), bounded further by an Isolated Debt Ceiling — "the maximum amount that can be borrowed against designated isolated assets" — with the same restriction restated: "Only Stablecoins may be borrowed against isolated assets" (.1.12). Isolation Mode is the borrower-side view: while in it, "only assets with Isolated Borrow enabled can be borrowed" (.1.21).

**Siloed borrowing** constrains the other direction, on a risky *debt asset*: "If Siloed Borrowing is Enabled, then when borrowing the asset, no other asset may be borrowed" (.1.22).

Both exist to stop a single questionable asset from becoming a vector into the rest of the pool. If a thinly traded collateral is manipulated upward, isolation caps the damage at a known stablecoin quantity rather than letting the attacker draw out any asset they choose. If a debt asset itself is the problem, siloing prevents it from being combined into a leveraged multi-asset position whose failure spans markets.

The cost is capital efficiency, and it is paid by the honest user: a position using isolated collateral cannot borrow the asset they may actually want, and a siloed borrow cannot be combined with anything. This is why the parameters are per-asset switches rather than global policy — the protocol pays the efficiency cost only where the asset warrants it, and the live GNO configuration (isolated collateral yes, $5,000,000 debt ceiling) shows the settings applied to exactly one weak collateral rather than to the whole market.
description: Isolated collateral restricts what a risky asset can borrow (stablecoins only, under a debt ceiling); siloed borrowing restricts what can be borrowed alongside a risky debt asset.
